description: What Task.await with a timeout returns: Done with the task's value, or TimedOut.
name: Await

description: The payload of a failed Result: its kind, message, code, details, cause and the place it was made.
name: Error

description: What File.stat returns: the kind, byte size, modification time, permission bits and owner of a file.
name: File.Info

description: A program started by Process.spawn, Process.spawn_captured or Process.spawn_channel.
name: Process

description: A signal of the operating system, which System.subscribe delivers on a channel.
name: System.Signal

description: The running task, from Task.current, which Task.monitor, Task.cancel and id take.
name: TaskRef
